scientific_integrity: Original source statements and standard earlier characterizations are credited; all independent validation is unperformed. Finite computations supplement a general proof.
scientific_limitations: Results require characteristic distinct from two and invertibility of the shifted adjacency matrix. Finite-field existence q>n+1 is sufficient. The graph expansion is defined relative to the displayed natural basis; the tensor form and generic facts about maximal ideals are prior. Possible earlier implicit classification remains a residual novelty risk.
title: Symmetric expanding evolution algebras with a simple socle and an exact ideal lattice
